name: ascii-box
title: ASCII box
description: A box-drawing frame that wraps any content and snaps to the glyph cell grid, with labels in its borders and a shade-glyph shadow.

name: ascii-button
title: ASCII button
description: A real button set in glyphs: a box-drawing frame around a label row that inverts like a terminal selection, with a spinner while loading.

name: ascii-card
title: ASCII card
description: A card framed in box-drawing glyphs, with its title set into the top border and an optional glyph glow lighting it from an edge or a corner.

name: ascii-fade
title: ASCII fade
description: A section edge that fades content into the background through a glyph density ramp, with a slow drift.

name: ascii-glow
title: ASCII glow
description: A glowing aura drawn in glyphs, falling off through any charset from an edge, a corner or any point, for heroes and cards.
